verdict.rationale: Graphite installs as a GitHub App, and its AI reviewer then automatically reviews all new pull requests in the selected repositories, with setup taking a few clicks and no configuration. The docs imply the agent leaves comments, but never explicitly say they are posted as native inline GitHub PR comments. A community report says GitLab is not supported. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of native inline comments on GitHub PRs, GitLab app support, evidence of how fast reviews arrive, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, the reviewer installs as a GitHub/GitLab app and posts reviews as native inline comments on my pull requests within minutes

citations.quote: you'll need to authenticate by installing the Graphite App (a GitHub App) on your organization.
Graphite Agent will now automatically review all new pull requests in the selected repositories
AI reviews can be enabled in just a few clicks, with no configuration required to start catching bugs in your pull requests.
Comment exclusions allow you to specify situations where Graphite Agent should not leave comments.
